decisions.reason: The source prohibits using genuine replacement leads for testing but does not change the requirement to preserve the MeetAlfred integration and existing campaigns.
The testing restriction does not change the deferred workflow for moving silent leads into MeetAlfred follow-up campaigns.
Prohibiting use of the replacement leads for testing does not alter the deferred HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization method.
The source imposes a test-data restriction and does not change the deferred automated email campaign.
The source does not modify the channel, automation mode, platform, or lifecycle of the LinkedIn campaign requirement.
The restriction on testing with genuine leads does not change MeetAlfred configuration or its required subscription plan.
The source does not change the deferred Zapier configuration requirement or its scope.
The prohibition concerns which leads may be used for integration testing and does not change the HubSpot lead-management features.
The lead-testing restriction is unrelated to campaign-domain registration, the registered domain, or the registrar.
The source does not affect the campaign mailbox's required Gmail compatibility.
The source does not change the requirement to warm up the campaign domain.
The restriction on using replacement leads for testing does not affect domain web forwarding or its destination.
